- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Challenges posed by the tourism industry include high living costs for workers and seasonal fluctuations in demand leading to financial instability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Despite challenges, tourism remains vital for jobs, revenue, and cultural exchange in Honolulu.
- [USER] User inquired about the environmental impact of tourism in Hawaii.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tourism has negatively impacted Hawaii's environment, including waste management issues and pollution from disposable plastics.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Transportation related to tourism contributes to congestion and air pollution.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Construction of new hotels and resorts can lead to habitat loss and increased demand for water and energy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hawaii has implemented policies for sustainable tourism, such as banning single-use plastics and promoting public transportation.
